skills.name: clone
skills.description: Clone the current conversation so the user can branch off and try a different approach.

skills.name: gha
skills.description: Analyze GitHub Actions failures and identify root causes

skills.name: half-clone
skills.description: Clone the later half of the current conversation, discarding earlier context to reduce token usage while preserving recent work.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Write or update a handoff document so the next agent with fresh context can continue this work.

skills.name: review-claudemd
skills.description: Review recent conversations to find improvements for CLAUDE.md files.
